messages.subject: Last D-RUG and Tea Time of Fall Quarter and Workshops Next Week!
messages.subject_clean: Last D-RUG and Tea Time of Fall Quarter and Workshops Next Week!
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!

This Thursday will be the last D-RUG and Tea Time for the Fall Quarter (details below).

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09
Tea Time: 1-2pm, DataLab Classroom, Library 360
Co-working: 2-4pm, DataLab Conference Room, Library 362

Additionally, next week DataLab will be running the following workshops. Make sure to register to reserve your spot.
Introduction to Computational Pedagogy <https://events.library.ucdavis.edu/event/instructor-training-2024> - Best practices for teaching scientific computing (ex data analysis with R and Python)
Introduction to Reproducible and Collaborative Computational Research Practices <https://events.library.ucdavis.edu/event/reproducible-research-intensive-2024> - Learn how to use Github!
R Basics <https://events.library.ucdavis.edu/event/r-basics-2024> - Learn R from the ground up. A great workshop for absolute beginners and also those with some experience, looking to fill in gaps in their knowledge.
Python Basics <https://events.library.ucdavis.edu/event/python-basics-2024> - Were you told you needed to learn python in addition to R? This is the workshop for you.

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse <https://d-rug.discourse.group/> site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
